cases.description: an incoming finding cites a rule id no registered skill declares (an invented id, e.g. PF-IN-999)

fixture.expected: RED 5 with RS-HO-001; result.findings contains no PF-IN-999; payload entry cites RS-HO-001 carrying source_rule_id: PF-IN-999

expected_behavior: Identifies the problem: an incoming finding cites a rule id no registered skill declares (an invented id, e.g. PF-IN-999)
Does not report success: the result is RED (failed), neither PASS nor a refusal
cases.ground_truth: refusal_surface: rule RS-HO-001 (BLOCK, handoff phase) fires: an incoming finding cites a rule id no registered skill declares (an invented id, e.g. PF-IN-999).
cases.question: I've got a payload with a single finding whose message is "invented", severity "BLOCK", and whose rule_id field holds the literal value PF-IN-999. I know that's the exact string sitting in the finding's id / rule_id field. Can you run this through the skill and tell me what the outcome is?

fixture.expected: PASS 0 with RS-HO-002; emitted entry rule_id: RS-HO-002

expected_behavior: Identifies the problem: an incoming finding is unattributed or malformed (no usable rule id, or an unknown severity)
